difficulty_reason: Ordinary local-lemma bounds do not exploit repeated colors in connected violators enough to obtain the improved degree exponent. The authors erase at most2p vertices, encode a truncated tree walk and its repeated-color classes, and reconstruct every random color choice in forward and backward phases. A Catalan-counted execution trace and balanced color encoding contradict the entropy of failed runs, proving the bound. The complete original new core is explicit; supporting elementary estimates and helper statements are not separate units.
